examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?
to draw a conclusion or move on

examples.text: Je suis content que ça t'amuse.

examples.trans: I do not want to stop you from having fun.

meanings.note: polite and neutral; salut is more casual

before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel
je ne crois pas = I don't think so
je ne crois pas = I don't think so
